ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1997
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Sales Tax Act, 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 28th February, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 28‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action; ,
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.--‑(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Sales Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force on the
date the Sales Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1996 (CIX of 1996) shall stand
repealed.

Amendment in the Sales Tax Act, 1990

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1997
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Sales Tax Act, 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 28th February, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 28‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action; ,
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment in the Sales Tax Act,
1990.‑‑In
the Sales Tax Act, 1990‑‑
(1) in section 2, in clause (46),‑‑
(1) in clause (d), the word
"and" occurring at the end shall be omitted;
(ii) in clause (e), for the
"colon" at the end the "semi colon" and the word
"and" shall be substituted; and
(iii) after clause (e) amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(f) in case the goods other
than taxable goods are supplied to a registered person for processing, the
value of supply of such processed goods shall mean the price excluding the
amount of sales tax which such goods will fetch on sale in the market;"
(2) in section 3, in subsection (2),
in the proviso, for the "full‑stop" at me end a "semi‑colon"
shall be substituted and after clause (d), amended as aforesaid, the following
new clause shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(e) taxable supplies made or
goods imported, specified in the Seventh Schedule, shall be charged to tax at
rate of ten per cent. of the value thereof";
(3) in section 3A, in subsection
(1), for the word "four" the word "two" shall be
substituted;
(4) in section 34, in subsection
(1), in clause (a), for the word "or" occurring at the end, the word
"and" shall be substituted;
(5) in section 67, for the word
"ten" the word "fourteen" shall be substituted;
(6) after section 70, the following
new section shall be added, namely:‑‑
"71. Special procedure ‑‑Notwithstanding
anything contained in the preceding sections, the Federal Government may, by
Notification in the official Gazette, prescribe the special procedure for scope
and payment of tax, registration, book keeping and invoicing requirements and
returns, etc. in respect of such supplies as may be specified therein. ";
(7) in the First Schedule, in Serial
No.21 in column (1), in entry relating thereto in column (2), after the word
"scrap" at the end, the brackets and the words "(excluding ship
plates obtained from ship‑breaking)" shall be added;
(8) in the Third Schedule, serial
No. 12 in column (1) and the entries relating thereto in columns Nos.(2) and
(3) shall be omitted;
(9) in the Fifth Schedule, after
Serial No.2 in column (1) and the entry relating thereto in column (2), the
following new serial number and entry relating thereto shall be added, namely:‑‑
"3. Supplies to duty free
shops, provided that in case of clearance from duty free shops against various
baggage rules issued under the Customs Act, 1969, (IV of 1969), the supplies
from duty free shops shall be treated as import for the purpose of levy of
sales tax. ";
(10) in the Sixth Schedule,‑‑
(i) in serial No. 13 in column (1),
in column, (2), after the word "verses" at the end, the semi‑colon
and the words "; other Holy books" shall be added;
(ii) in Serial No. 17 in column (1),
after item (viii) in column (2' and the entry relating thereto the following
new item and the entry relating thereto shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(ix) Containers meant and used
for packing of goods for export by air, sea or land routes; and containers
stuffed with imported goods if these containers are meant for re‑export,
or otherwise."; and
